profile.headline: Software Engineer at Heroku / Salesforce
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: A dedicated software engineer, focusing on cloud-native design, networking, and distributed systems in an effort to facilitate a better development and operational experience for users of the Heroku platform.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer (LMTS)
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (SMTS)
positions.description:
- Working on the new L4 gateway that proxies all traffic to customers' apps running in the Heroku common runtime.
- Assisting in effort to block TLS 1.0/1.1 traffic for customers' apps.
- Enabling migration off of EC2-classic to new VPC-backed environments.
- Servicing incidents and fulfilling general on-call responsibilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer (MTS)
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Designing and developing in-house tools and services as part of the Developer Productivity Engineering Team
-Work involves full-stack development, with an emphasis on making AWS more accessible to our engineers by providing intuitive tools in addition to better metrics and monitoring capabilities
-Recent project involves utilizing Docker and ECS to build an opinionated containerized application deployment service
-Implementing scaling, monitoring, instrumentation, and alerting to bring services to production readiness
-Providing support as on-call engineer
-Work emphasizes distributed systems, cloud-native design, using micro-services, and scalable infrastructure

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Designed and developed in-house tools and services as part of the Core Engineering Team
-Work involved full-stack development, with an emphasis on making AWS more accessible to our engineers by providing intuitive tools in addition to better metrics and monitoring capabilities
-Utilizing Docker and ECS to build an opinionated container-supported deployment service

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Designed and developed in-house tools and services as part of the Core Engineering Team
-Work involved full-stack development, with an emphasis on making AWS more accessible to our engineers by providing intuitive tools in addition to better metrics and monitoring capabilities
-Utilizing Docker and ECS to build an opinionated container-supported deployment service

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Designed and developed in-house tools and services as part of the Core Engineering Team
-Work involved full-stack development, with an emphasis on making AWS more accessible to our engineers by providing intuitive tools in addition to better metrics and monitoring capabilities
-Utilizing Docker and ECS to build an opinionated container-supported deployment service

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Worked on Java-backed API for interacting with large graph database representing the "Active and Available Inventory" for AT&T's future software-defined network, including automated test suite platform to verify API responses
-Previously worked on a team writing and editing ILOG and flow files to match User Stories in an effort to maintain network service assurance
-Acting as an "Aspire" mentor to help create and teach a curriculum focused on web development to talented high school seniors as well as organize and run events to educate and motivate college students pursuing technology-related studies
-Participating in "Developer Time" meetings in which colleagues discuss and develop solutions to mathematics/programming-based problems
-Previously participated in two program-wide team-entry hackathons, each with an emphasis on mobile development, exercising skills in HTML, CSS, Javascript, and JSON (taking 2nd place in most recent competition)

positions.title: Intern on Software Documentation Team
positions.description:
-Developed a Python-based software tool to perform batch conversions of HTML files, re-writing the files in well-formed XML while satisfying specific structures requirements
-Wrote a Python script to extract information regarding various error messages that could be thrown while using Numerix's financial solutions software, "CrossAsset", organized the messages based on meaning/content, formulated reports suggesting ways in which error messages should be revised for clarity, and created a basic classification system to eventually be included in the software's documentation

positions.title: Mathematics Peer Mentor
positions.description:
-Instructed Calculus I & II students during recitation
-Graded students’ weekly homework and answer questions
-Aimed to foster a profound understanding of concepts in students, drawing them away from the recipe-oriented style of learning that introductory calculus courses often employ

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
-Program offers exceptional high school students the opportunity to study mathematical topics that go      far beyond scope of typical school curriculum 
-Taught and encouraged my own team of students
-Together delved into topics such as number theory, graph theory, probability, and combinatorics

company.name: Young Scholars Program, sponsored by DIMACS

honors.title: 2nd Place in Fall Mobilithon 2015
honors.description:
-Worked on a team of 6 individuals to develop a mobile site for the Vietnam Veteran's Memorial Fund as part of a hackathon over a period of 3 weeks
-Utilized various web development languages such as HTML, CSS, JSON, and AngularJs
-Honed soft skills such as understanding of Agile software methodology, communication, and teamwork
honors.issuer: Issued by AT&T's Mobile Center of Excellence · Oct 2015

honors.title: Presidential Scholar
honors.description: Full tuition, room, & board for 4 years

volunteerExperiences.description:
-Help organize and execute programs that expose high school and college students to opportunities in the world of technology
-Develop curriculum for programs and mentor students during hands-on learning sessions
